## Apply receipt

**status:** completed  
**start HEAD:** `b146cdee13e23261c3f43e31fa87af3b06584fda`  
**commit:** `fd042e738ab57c2b44b2dbeb19947565f9f229db`  
**title:** `fix(package): stabilize native build and install boundary`  
**forward descendant:** yes (strict); no amend/rebase  
**worktree:** clean after commit

### Root causes closed

1. **Concurrent truncate race:** `scripts/build-rename-no-replace.mjs` compiled directly onto the published `dist/recorder/rename_no_replace.node`, so parallel `prepack`/build could expose a partial binding to live Recorder loads.
2. **Unsound pack/install boundary:** pack shipped a host `.node` without C source or the build entrypoint, and install never rebuilt for the installing host — a Darwin artifact could satisfy Ubuntu.
3. **Opaque platform admission:** no `os`/`cpu` boundary; unsupported hosts failed only at `dlopen`.

### Changes (authorized seams only)

| Seam | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `scripts/build-rename-no-replace.mjs` | Single publisher: compile into `.native-build-staging/` (same FS, outside packed `dist/`), validate size/magic, atomic `rename` over published path, load-check published binding; clean temp on failure; explicit darwin/linux × x64/arm64 + toolchain diagnostics |
| `package.json` | `files` includes native source/build script; `os`/`cpu` admission; `build:native` + `install` (native only); `build:recorder`/`prepack` = tsc + native |
| `README.md` | Runtime OS/CPU, `cc` + `node_api.h`, install vs prepack lifecycle |
| `.gitignore` | `.native-build-staging/`, `*.tmp.node` |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | Seed foreign non-ELF binding before `npm ci`; prove host ELF load; packed-consumer install + foreign-seed rebuild proof |
| `test/recorder-package-lifecycle.test.ts` | Concurrent build/load + no dist scratch; pack inventory + no scratch in tarball; foreign/stale rebuild with host magic/load; platform admission; existing consumer `.bin` matrix |
| `test/reviewer-package-lifecycle.test.ts` | Pack path inventory includes native scripts |
| `test/recorder-transaction.test.ts` | Raw-cleanup saboteur uses private `TMPDIR` so it cannot attach to another test’s scratch (production unchanged) |
| `dist/recorder/rename_no_replace.node` | Rebuilt via new publisher |

**Not changed:** docket no-replace publication semantics, single child spawn, role/Soul/schema/runtime behavior, AC weakening.
